_comment: Tapetide MCP server config examples. Copy the variant you need into your client's config file and replace YOUR_TOKEN with your token from https://tapetide.com/settings/tokens. Do NOT commit a file containing your real token.

_where_to_put_it.cursor: .cursor/mcp.json (variant 1 or 2; sign in via Settings -> MCP for OAuth)
_where_to_put_it.claude_code_cli: claude mcp add --transport http tapetide https://mcp.tapetide.com/mcp
